thread:
Maria G: Handoff — I'm oncall til 11:30 PDT today. Quick heads-up for AcmeCorp prelaunch tomorrow 09:00 PDT. They have a strict SLA (99.95%) for first 2 hours. Main things:
- Load test at 02:00 PDT (ramp to ~200 rps, short duration)
- Canary deploy at 06:00 PDT
- PR that changes batching: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821
- KV cache warmup recommended
Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/acme-prelaunch
If anything looks off during the loadtest, page SRE and tag me. Leaving detailed notes below.

Ajay R: Thanks Maria. Copying @SRE and @eng-infra. A couple quick checks:
- Can you confirm which GPU pool AcmeProd is pinned to? I want to ensure we have headroom.
- I'll temporarily tighten rate limits for acme-prod API key to prevent noisy neighbor issues.
- Added a Datadog monitor for 5xx spikes and p95 latency: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitor/12345

Liz C: I can take 11:30–03:00. One question: is the DB read-replica maintenance still on for 02:30? If so we should move it.

Sam T: Deploy-bot shows canary pipeline queued for 06:00 — pipeline id `canary-2026-06-17-77`.
Small note: PR #4821 bumps default batch_size 8->12 which may increase tail latency on short sequences. I added a smoke test in CI and a rollback toggle.
Smoke command: `./scripts/smoke_acme.sh --profile=acme` (runs a 5m perf check)

deploy-bot: Canary pipeline `canary-2026-06-17-77` queued by @Sam T — status: queued

Maria G: DB maintenance was postponed to 04:00 PDT, so it's outside the peak window. Ajay — thanks for the rate limiter change. I also added an emergency fallback route to `gpt-small-v2` if latency > 600ms for >1m. Fallback live in route config: `fallback: gpt-small-v2`.

Ajay R: Ack. I'll set escalation: page SRE first, then eng-oncall if no ack in 2m. Also posted a short runbook snippet in the repo under `ops/acme-readme.md`.

Liz C: Oncall notes: I'll watch autoscaler, quota, and kernel OOM logs. If autoscaler fails to scale GPUs, I'll trigger manual pool bump and notify infra.

Sam T: Quick checklist for whoever is taking overnight:
1) Confirm canary passes smoke tests
2) Run KV cache warmup at 01:20 PDT (`./ops/kv_warmup.sh acme`)
3) Verify embedding service health (endpoint /embeddings/health)
4) Ensure alert thresholds are correct (p95=400ms, error_rate=0.5%)
I'll run KV warmup at 01:20.

Maria G: Perfect. I'll leave these notes in the runbook and hand off in ~10m. Ping me for any immediate escalations. :thumbsup:
